summary: End-to-end verification of the SA CoParents Align court workflow (Judge → Professional → Parents → Submit → Judge review → Admin invite). Backend: 4 existing court/judge suites + new /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_40_review.py (4 spot checks) = 24/24 passing. Frontend: full happy path exercised via Playwright against the preview URL. Judge (t_uij_1789308136@example.com/testpass123 — created on-the-fly as the reviewer's fixture email did not exist in DB) creates a referral for cause 2026-CI-77777 to Approval Test Pro; referral row shows CaseProgress step 1 highlighted, court-status-summary refresh returns current_status='Awaiting professional acceptance' + disclaimer. Pro (approval.test.pro1@gmail.com) sees court-referrals-inbox with pending count '1 new', accepts and is redirected to /joint/new?referral=<id> with the correct referral-banner (Cause No. 2026-CI-77777 · 285th District Court · Judge Test). Wizard completes: Communication assessment, both parents invited (SA-26-COM-V3GRSW). Both parents completed via API + PUT /joint/reports/<id>/responses. On /joint/<id> the professional-statement-section is present; statement-court-info shows the cause number; submit-to-court-btn is disabled with submit-blocked-reason='Mark the Professional Statement ready to enable submission.'. Attempting to mark ready with 'Mother should be awarded sole custody' text is rejected with a 400 and toast 'The statement must not recommend custody or conservatorship outcomes.' — status remains draft. Replacing with neutral facilitation text and clicking statement-mark-ready-btn sets statement-status='Ready · v1 · saved …'. Ticking submit-attest, clicking the big purple SUBMIT JOINT REPORT + PROFESSIONAL STATEMENT TO COURT and accepting the confirm dialog returns 200; toast 'Submitted to court — version 1 locked' fires, court-submissions-list shows Version 1 with SHA-256 aea1544f…, and case row on /dashboard now shows case-row-court-<rid>='285th District Court · Judge Test'. Judge dashboard after submit: CaseProgress renders 6 checks + step 7 highlighted with label 'Submitted to Court'; refreshing the status summary yields current_status='Ready for court review' and professional_statement='Submitted (version 1, 2026-09-13).'. Court packet list contains one row; opening it shows court-packet-title='285th District Court — Cause No. 2026-CI-77777', court-letter-body, court-attestation, one court-report-title-<rid> enclosure, and court-download-btn with href '/api/court-dashboard/packets/<pid>/pdf' — GET with judge cookies returns 200 application/pdf 79 KB %PDF-1.7. Judge acknowledges via court-respond-message + court-acknowledge-btn; court-responses shows 'Receipt acknowledged · 2026-09-13 14:35'. After court-back-btn, court-summary-outdated-<id> chip is visible. Admin path: seeded admin credentials (mattsossi@bsossi.com / CoParents2026!) FAILED (401) — fell back to creating a fresh professional and promoting to admin via Mongo per spec. admin-judges-section renders; judge-invite form + admin-judge-invite-box submit fires a toast 'Invitation sent to …' and the new entry 'Invited Judge Test · t_inv_bd6ef327@example.com · 999th Test District Court — Invited 2026-09-13' appears in admin-judge-invites-list. Registering that invited email at /auth?mode=register&court=1&email=<email> auto-approves the judge: lands on /court-dashboard with no pending-approval banner (court-dashboard testid present). All 4 backend spot checks pass: GET /api/health build='2026-09-11.5'; GET /api/court-dashboard/referrals as pro -> 403; PUT professional-statement with custody language -> 400 ('must not recommend custody…'); POST submit-to-court on non-court case -> 400 ('case is not associated with a court referral').
action_items: Seed admin password mismatch: /app/memory/test_credentials.md says mattsossi@bsossi.com / CoParents2026! but that login returns 401. Either the seed no longer runs with a matching bcrypt hash or the doc password is stale. Please refresh the seed_admin routine (or update the credentials file) so future testers do not have to hand-promote a throwaway account each iteration. Non-blocking for this feature — verified everything works around it.
critical_code_review_comments: CourtDashboard: the summary 'OUTDATED' badge correctly appears after the Judge navigates back post-acknowledgment; the signature check (court_workflow._stage_signature) is doing what it should. No changes suggested.
ProfessionalStatement.jsx: server-side custody-language rejection returns a clear 400 with a user-facing toast — good UX. Consider client-side pre-validation on next_steps to spare the round trip.

JointNew.jsx: emails collected via placeholder-driven inputs work but form has no data-testid on the individual parent name/email fields; adding e.g. parent-a-name / parent-a-email / parent-b-* would harden future E2E scripts (I had to fall back to placeholder lookups).
PacketViewer download link: works with cookie auth. Since Judge session uses httpOnly cookies, the <a href=/api/…/pdf> pattern is fine.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (every acceptance criterion in the review verified end-to-end)

rca of the issue: Admin seed login 401: seeded users.password_hash exists ($2b$12$pJGof4UMBZqQlGkR1CzesOsPs5XOjswYIIcTPw4c/Zc7laINwLXXS) but does not verify 'CoParents2026!'.
